    • setPosition

      public void setPosition(Color color, int cell)
      Sets the position of a player on the flight board. This method updates the target label for the specified color and cell.
      Parameters:
      color - The color of the player whose position is being set.
      cell - The cell index where the player's position should be set.

    • freePosition

      public void freePosition(Color color)
      Free the position of a player on the flight board. This method clears the target label for the specified color and removes it from the color-cell map.
      Parameters:
      color - The color of the player whose position is being freed.

    • setupBackButton

      public void setupBackButton()
      Sets up the back button functionality. This method defines the action to be performed when the back button is clicked, allowing the user to navigate back to the appropriate screen based on the current game state.
